extracted.intended_audience: PR and communications professionals, marketing teams, and organizations (Fortune 500s, startups, small businesses) seeking multimedia content production and distribution services
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service-level criteria for producing and distributing multimedia-enhanced press releases, videos, virtual media tours, and event broadcasts to amplify news and drive engagement. Focuses on production quality, distribution guarantees, repurposing assets, and package options (MNR, MNR Pro, Interactive, Deluxe).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compelling, engaging, unforgettable content
rubrics_metrics.description: Tell your story with compelling, engaging, unforgettable content
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for content that brings your story to life and resonates with audiences; this is the stated goal for all content produced by the studio.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality video production
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether you need an animated explainer or a live-action documentary, a single promotional video or a full video library that engages your customers for hours—Cision has the expertise, the capacity, and the artistry to deliver the content you need, when you need it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliverables should match the project scope (single spot to full library) and business goals (engagement, lead generation, sales); emphasizes professional, award-winning production values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with award-winning video artists
rubrics_metrics.description: Our innovative team has garnered more than 100 awards for live action video, 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics and PSA production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards are presented as an indicator of creative quality and expertise to prefer this team for production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local or global production capability (including bilingual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Go as local or global as you want — Stage a single shoot in your home office, or multiple shoots in locations around the world. Our global production resources can handle it all. We can even produce content for bilingual audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose production scale and geographic reach appropriate to target markets; include bilingual production when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage and refresh existing multimedia assets
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re experts at refreshing existing video content with audio-only sound bites, or with new content captured with traditional or remote filming methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repurpose existing assets to maximize ROI; refresh rather than always re-shoot—options include audio soundbites and remote capture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-service approach and state-of-the-art execution
rubrics_metrics.description: We handle every step of the production process, from concepts and storyboards to the shooting, video editing and other post-production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect end-to-end service that delivers world-class creative agency-quality deliverables and keeps communications on the leading edge of visual communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Virtual Media Tours (VMT) for rapid broadcast amplification
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtual Media Tours let your spokesperson reach a large audience quickly—with back-to-back television, radio, or online interviews on top outlets, over the course of several hours in a single day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use VMTs to amplify events, launches, or campaign kickoffs; customize tours to prioritize target markets and include nationally syndicated and local shows; can be executed via satellite, Zoom or Skype.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media relations expertise and end-to-end tour production
rubrics_metrics.description: Our team produces more than 200 media tours every year. We’ll work together with you on everything from initial consultation to audio and video production services, media notification and pitching, and post-event reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on experienced teams for pitching, scheduling, production, and measurement; volume/experience used as quality assurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create repurposable follow-on content
rubrics_metrics.description: Every engagement includes production of a generic interview you can repurpose in subsequent marketing and PR efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure projects deliver assets designed for reuse across marketing channels to extend value beyond the initial placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional talent procurement
rubrics_metrics.description: If you need a spokesperson, we'll find and contract with the right one through our extensive talent agent partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procure on-screen talent when needed via agency relationships rather than relying on client-supplied spokespeople.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Video Distribution to maximize ROI on social channels
rubrics_metrics.description: With Social Video Distribution, our award-winning video team transforms your existing content—press releases, blogs, white papers and more—into a compelling, social media-optimized video that’s guaranteed to drive more views and greater engagement on Facebook and Instagram.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optimize format, length, and creative for platform (Facebook/Instagram) to increase views and engagement; repurpose existing long-form assets into social-ready clips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event production expertise for live and virtual events
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether you need teleconferencing expertise to support an earnings call, an experienced producer for your next webcast, or a skilled team to broadcast your event on Facebook Live—our event production team will ensure a professional presentation, and a flawless experience from start to finish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use production support to guarantee technical and presentation quality for webcasts, live streams, and teleconferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multichannel News Release (MNR) — combined multimedia landing page
rubrics_metrics.description: A Multichannel News Release (MNR) combines your press release and up to 6 multimedia assets—video, images, audio and more—into a single, Cision-created and hosted, branded landing page experience focused on your story and message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an MNR to centralize multimedia assets and present a branded landing page that supports distribution and pitching.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR distribution and guaranteed placements/metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of your content across PR Newswire’s industry-leading extensive audience generating network, including full national wire transmission to thousands of websites, media outlets, and journalists, with guaranteed placement on 200 local broadcast media websites via Cision-exclusive partnerships; 10,000 landing page views, guaranteed; posting of one video to YouTube, Vimeo or the video portal of your choice; lead generation features.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MNRs come with explicit distribution guarantees (200 local broadcast placements, 10,000 landing page views) and features intended to drive visibility and leads; use these metrics when selecting distribution packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR Pro — paid native placement and impression guarantees
rubrics_metrics.description: MNR Pro adds paid placement of your press release as a native article on relevant websites, and native ads promoting the article on other high-traffic pages within those sites. Amplify your story with guaranteed publication and 150K guaranteed impressions on the web sites your target audiences follow and trust.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose MNR Pro when you need guaranteed native publication and a large guaranteed impression count (150K) to reach target web audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR Interactive — engagement and data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: MNR Interactive transforms your news into engaging quizzes, flip-books, ‘live’ charts and more. Your audience will spend more time with your news, and you’ll gather more data on the information and experiences that interest them most.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use interactive formats to increase dwell time and collect first-party engagement data to inform future communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR Deluxe — comprehensive combined strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: MNR Deluxe combines all our MNR options—branded multimedia landing page, paid placement, and interactive content—into a single seamless experience that keeps influencers, journalists, customers, and prospects engaged from start to finish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select MNR Deluxe for an all-in-one content marketing strategy that layers branded landing page, paid native distribution, and interactive experiences.
